LABEL: SIGNUP_OK
lifted_nl: whenever signup(u,p,role) is called, it must hold that u ∉ dom(roleMap(role)) and after success roleMap(role) becomes roleMap(role) ∪ {u ↦ hash(p)}
Postcondition: C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual ∧ Compl'=Compl ∧ roleMap(role)' = roleMap(role) ∪ {u ↦ hash(p)}

LABEL: LOGIN_OK
lifted_nl: whenever login(u,p) is called, it must hold that hash(p) = C(u) and u ∉ ran(T) and after success a new token t is added to map T mapping t to u
Precondition: ∃ r ∈ {Customer,Plumber,Manager} : u ∈ dom(roleMap(r)) ∧ hash(p) = roleMap(r)(u) ∧ u ∉ ran(T)
Postcondition: ∃ t ∉ dom(T) : T' = T ∪ {t ↦ u} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ Qual'=Qual ∧ Compl'=Compl

LABEL: LOGOUT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever logout(t) is called, it must hold that t ∈ dom(T) and after logout the token t is removed from T
Postcondition: T' = T \ {t} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ Qual'=Qual ∧ Compl'=Compl

LABEL: SIGNUP_OK
lifted_nl: whenever signup(u,p,role) called, u not in dom(R); after success R becomes R union {u|->hash(p)}
Postcondition: C' = (if role=Customer then C ∪ {u↦hash(p)} else C) ∧ P' = (if role=Plumber then P ∪ {u↦hash(p)} else P) ∧ M' = (if role=Manager then M ∪ {u↦hash(p)} else M) ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual ∧ Compl'=Compl

LABEL: ONBOARD_STEP_OK
lifted_nl: whenever submitOnboardingStep(p,k) is called, it must hold that QualState(p) = STEP_k and token(p) ∈ dom(T) AND whenever submitOnboardingStep(p,k) is called, QualState(p) becomes STEP_{k+1} AND whenever SubmitOnboardingStep(6) is called, it must hold that state becomes ONBOARD_DONE.
Postcondition: Qual' = (Qual \ {p}) ∪ {p↦(if k<6 then STEP_{k+1} else ONBOARD_DONE)} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Compl'=Compl

LABEL: QUAL_INIT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever InitialQualificationApplication is called, it must hold that QualState = Q_INIT. AND whenever InitialQualificationApplication is called, it must hold that QualState becomes UNDER_EXAM.
Postcondition: Qual' = Qual ∪ {p↦UNDER_EXAM} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Compl'=Compl

LABEL: QUAL_SEMI_OK
lifted_nl: whenever Semi-Qualify(p) is called, it must hold that QualState(p) = UNDER_EXAM AND always after Semi-Qualify(p) succeeds, QualState(p) becomes TRAINING.
Postcondition: Qual' = Qual ∪ {p↦TRAINING} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Compl'=Compl

LABEL: FULLY_QUALIFY_ACTIVATE_OK
lifted_nl: whenever Fully-Qualify(p) is called, it must hold that QualState(p) = UNDER_EXAM; always after fullyQualify(c,p) succeeds, QualState becomes ACTIVE.
Postcondition: Qual'=Qual[p|->ACTIVE] AND C'=C AND T'=T AND Compl'=Compl

LABEL: DISQUALIFY_REJECT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever disqualify(c,p) is called, it must hold that QualState = UNDER_EXAM; always after disqualify(c,p) succeeds, QualState becomes REJECTED.
Postcondition: Qual'=Qual[p|->REJECTED] AND C'=C AND T'=T AND Compl'=Compl

LABEL: SUSPEND_PLUMBER_OK
lifted_nl: whenever SuspendPlumber(p) is called, it must hold that QualState(p)=ACTIVE; always after SuspendPlumber(p) succeeds, QualState(p) becomes SUSPENDED.
Postcondition: Qual'=Qual[p|->SUSPENDED] AND C'=C AND T'=T AND Compl'=Compl

LABEL: REINSTATE_PLUMBER_OK
lifted_nl: whenever ReinstatePlumber(p) is called, it must hold that QualState(p)=SUSPENDED AND QualState(p) becomes ACTIVE
Postcondition: Qual'=Qual \ {p} ∪ {p|->ACTIVE} AND T'=T AND C'=C AND P'=P AND Compl'=Compl

LABEL: DELETE_PLUMBER_ACCOUNT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever deletePlumberAccount(p) is called, it must hold that p ∈ dom(Qual) AND p is removed from Qual and p is removed from P
Postcondition: Qual'=Qual \ {p} AND P'=P \ {p} AND T'=T AND C'=C AND Compl'=Compl

LABEL: RAISE_COMPLAINT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever RaiseComplaint(c) is called, it must hold that c ∈ dom(T) AND QualState(c)=CUSTOMER_IDLE AND a new ComplaintRecord is added to Compl with state RAISED
Postcondition: Compl'=Compl ∪ {newId|->ComplaintRecord{state=RAISED}} AND T'=T AND C'=C AND P'=P AND Qual'=Qual

LABEL: ASSIGN_PLUMBER_TO_COMPLAINT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever AssignPlumberToComplaint(cr,p) is called, it must hold that cr ∈ dom(Compl) and Compl(cr).state = RAISED; whenever assignPlumberToComplaint(c,plumberId,complaintId) is called, it must hold that plumberId ∈ dom(Qual) ∧ Qual(plumberId)=ACTIVE; after assignPlumberToComplaint(c,plumberId,complaintId) succeeds, Compl(complaintId) becomes {plumber: plumberId, state: ASSIGNED}
Precondition: complaintId ∈ dom(Compl) ∧ Compl(complaintId).state = RAISED ∧ plumberId ∈ dom(Qual) ∧ Qual(plumberId)=ACTIVE
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {complaintId |-> Compl(complaintId)[plumber := plumberId, state := ASSIGNED]} ∧ C'=C ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual

LABEL: PLUMBER_ACCEPTS_ASSIGNMENT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever plumberAcceptsAssignment(p,complaintId) is called, it must hold that Compl(complaintId).state = ASSIGNED ∧ Compl(complaintId).plumber = p; whenever plumber accepts assignment, Complaint state becomes UNDER_EXAM_C
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {complaintId |-> Compl(complaintId)[state := UNDER_EXAM_C]} ∧ C'=C ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual

LABEL: PLUMBER_REJECTS_ASSIGNMENT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever plumber rejects assignment, it must hold that Complaint state = ASSIGNED and calling plumber = assigned plumber; whenever plumber rejects assignment, Complaint state becomes RAISED; whenever plumber rejects assignment, plumber field becomes cleared
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {complaintId |-> Compl(complaintId)[state := RAISED, plumber := ⊥]} ∧ C'=C ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual

LABEL: RAISE_QUOTATION_OK
lifted_nl: whenever raise quotation is called, it must hold that complaint.state = UNDER_EXAM_C, and complaint.quotation becomes items and complaint.state becomes QUOTATION_RAISED.
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {complaintId |-> Compl[complaintId] ⊕ {quotation ↦ items, state ↦ QUOTATION_RAISED}} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual

LABEL: APPROVE_QUOTATION_OK
lifted_nl: whenever approveQuotation is called, it must hold that Compl[complaintId] = QUOTATION_RAISED, and Compl[complaintId] becomes UNDER_EXEC.
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {complaintId |-> Compl[complaintId] ⊕ {state ↦ UNDER_EXEC}} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual

LABEL: REJECT_QUOTATION_OK
lifted_nl: whenever rejectQuotation is called, it must hold that Compl[complaintId] = QUOTATION_RAISED, and ComplaintRecord becomes ABANDONED.
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {complaintId |-> Compl[complaintId] ⊕ {state ↦ ABANDONED}} ∧ C'=C ∧ P'=P ∧ M'=M ∧ T'=T ∧ Qual'=Qual

LABEL: MARK_TASK_COMPLETED_OK
lifted_nl: whenever markTaskCompleted(c) is called, it must hold that ComplaintRecord.state = UNDER_EXEC AND ComplaintRecord becomes PAYMENT_PENDING
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {c |-> Compl(c)[state := PAYMENT_PENDING]} ∧ C' = C ∧ P' = P ∧ M' = M ∧ T' = T ∧ Qual' = Qual

LABEL: MAKE_PAYMENT_OK
lifted_nl: whenever Make Payment is called, it must hold that ComplaintRecord.state = PAYMENT_PENDING AND after success ComplaintRecord.state becomes DONE
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {c |-> Compl(c)[state := DONE]} ∧ C' = C ∧ P' = P ∧ M' = M ∧ T' = T ∧ Qual' = Qual

LABEL: SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_OK
lifted_nl: whenever Submit Feedback is called, it must hold that ComplaintRecord.state = DONE AND f is added to map FeedbackMap
Postcondition: Compl' = Compl ∪ {c |-> Compl(c)[feedback := f]} ∧ C' = C ∧ P' = P ∧ M' = M ∧ T' = T ∧ Qual' = Qual
